---
title: Margin layout
reference-location: margin
format:
  preprint-typst:
    keep-typ: true
---

Margin content must sit in the margin, not over the body text. This paragraph has a footnote, which becomes a margin note.[^1] The body text continues for a while so that any overlap with the margin note would be clearly visible on the page, which is what this test checks.

[^1]: A footnote shown as a margin note.

::: {.column-margin}
A margin block placed next to this paragraph.
:::

More body text that follows the margin block and should keep its full width without colliding with any of the content in the margin column on the right.
